ns2:course.label: Special Problems in Architectural Design
ns2:course.description: Individual investigation of building types and systems, aesthetic theories, programming and other problems in architectural design. 2 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Restricted to Graduate Students.
